questions.q:

questions.explain: To find the number of farms that do not raise cows, sum the values of all the regions completely outside circle $C$. These are the farms raising only sheep (12), only pigs (5), and both sheep and pigs but not cows (2). $12 + 5 + 2 = 19$. Alternatively, total farms in $C = 13 + 10 + 1 + 4 = 28$. $47 - 28 = 19$.
